notYourSide: You can only move your own side right now.
unknownPiece: There is no such piece in this game.
unknownSystem: There is no such system in this game.
notOwner: This piece belongs to the other side.
notInFromSystem: The piece is not in the origin system.
sameSystem: The piece is already in this system.
notAdjacent: The systems are not adjacent: you cannot move there.
notYourTurn: It is the other side's turn now.
handoffPending: First confirm who is playing now.
handoffNotAvailable: Passing the turn is only available in a two-player game.
rulesetUnavailable: The Rise of the Empire ruleset is not available yet. Choose “Base game”.
modeUnavailable: The physical components mode is not available yet. Choose “Digital game”.
gameOver: The game is over — no more moves are accepted.
commandUnavailable: This action is not available with this game's rules.
wrongPhase: This action is only available in the command phase.
unknownLeader: There is no such leader in this game.
leaderNotInPool: This leader is not in your pool — pick a leader from the pool.
leaderCannotActivate: This leader cannot activate systems — pick another one.
noActivation: Activate a system with a leader first.
notActivatedSystem: Units can only move into the activated system.
pinnedByLeader: Units in a system with your leader cannot move.
immobileUnit: This unit cannot move (it is a structure).
insufficientCapacity: Not enough transport: add ships from the same system or leave ground units and fighters behind.
